security_blockers: Vault TLS listener configuration inconsistent: tls_disable=false with cert paths, but api_addr/cluster_addr=https:// expects TLS; however docker-compose healthcheck uses -tls-skip-verify masking TLS failures
CA private key (ca.key) deployed in config/vault-tls/ - must be removed post-cert-generation per PKI best practices
CSR (vault.csr) and serial file (ca.srl) not cleaned up after cert generation
Docker secrets mechanism defined but NOT used exclusively: api, postgres, redis services use ${VAR} plaintext env var substitution instead of Docker secret FILE references
All 8 secret files in secrets/ have 664 permissions (group/other readable) instead of required 600
secrets/ directory and config/vault-tls/ NOT in .gitignore - risk of committing production credentials
4 API keys contain placeholder values (elevenlabs_key, veo_key, runway_key, luma_key) - deployment will fail at runtime
9 services expose unnecessary ports on host: postgres(5432), redis(6379), vault(8200/8201), api(3000/9090), prometheus(9091), grafana(3001), alertmanager(9093) - only nginx 80/443 should be exposed
Vault UI enabled in production (ui = true) - unnecessary attack surface

Vault starts sealed; healthcheck passes when sealed (vault status -tls-skip-verify returns 0 when sealed); api depends_on vault:healthy starts api BEFORE Vault is unsealed - API cannot access secrets/transit
API-to-Vault TLS incomplete: VAULT_ADDR=https://vault:8200 but no VAULT_CACERT, VAULT_CLIENT_CERT, or VAULT_CLIENT_KEY configured in api service
nginx TLS certificates missing: config/nginx-tls/ empty but nginx.conf references /etc/nginx/tls/fullchain.pem and privkey.pem - nginx will fail to start on port 443
security_recommendations: Fix vault.hcl: ensure tls_disable=false, verify cert paths, ensure api_addr/cluster_addr=https:// consistent
Remove ca.key from config/vault-tls/ after cert generation (setup-secrets.sh line 131 shows intent but file persists)
Clean up vault.csr and ca.srl from config/vault-tls/
Migrate all service environment variables to use Docker secrets FILE mechanism: e.g., POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/postgres_password instead of POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
Enforce chmod 600 on all secret files in setup-secrets.sh (currently only recommends, does not enforce)
Replace placeholder API keys with actual values before production deployment
Remove all non-nginx port bindings from docker-compose.prod.yaml (postgres, redis, vault, api, prometheus, grafana, alertmanager) - use internal docker network only
Set ui = false in config/vault.hcl for production
Add explicit unseal step: either use Vault auto-unseal (KMS/HSM) or add init/unseal container that runs before api depends_on
Configure API service with VAULT_CACERT=/vault/tls/ca.crt and verify TLS connection
Generate/provide valid nginx TLS certificates (fullchain.pem, privkey.pem) in config/nginx-tls/
Consider CSP improvement: replace 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' with nonces/hashes
Set Vault audit log mode to 0600 in vault.hcl
Change Grafana admin username from hardcoded 'admin' to configurable value
Use least-privilege PostgreSQL role instead of superuser 'postgres' for application
